name: Ren Qiao

behavior.core_traits: restless, observant, self-possessed, more comfortable in the saddle or among scouts than in ceremonial staff discussion
behavior.speech_pattern: reports terrain and enemy behavior in concrete images before offering interpretation
behavior.values: seeing for himself, routes, timing, honest scouting, bringing useful information back instead of chasing glory
behavior.conflict_style: pushes back when headquarters asks reconnaissance to become an undeclared battle
behavior.individual_tell: scrapes dried mud from a boot or glove while answering questions after a ride
behavior.professional_bias: thinks in sight lines, approach times, concealment, and what a patrol can verify without becoming trapped

narration_rule: Static behavior guidance only; mutable goals, relationships, knowledge, health, authority, and outcomes remain in live state.
